name: Dick LeBeau's Zone Blitz Fire Zone Family
description: The definitive zone-blitz system: true 5-man pressures where a defensive lineman or safety trades his rush lane for a rat/hook zone while replacement blitzers attack vacated gaps. Every call pairs 3-deep/3-under fire zone coverage behind disguised rotations from Cover 2 and single-high shells, forcing hot answers directly into dropped rushers.
